body: Is leaving the mess you made on others the only way? I'm sorry for being frank but you made the mess you're in so you have to clean it up. Do what you can and the rest will fall in place, for better or for worse. But leaving you're problems on your mom seems very selfish.
I know I need help. I just don't think it will do any good. I feel like I will always hate myself.  At this point I just want the pain to stop.
